answer.title: Automate CRM Lead Creation from Quote Request Emails
answer.trigger: A new quote request email is received from a potential customer.
steps: Receive the incoming quote request email.
Extract the customer details, job description, and location using AI.
Check if a lead already exists in the CRM system.
Create a new lead in the CRM with the extracted information.
answer.ai_help: Extracts relevant customer and job details from the email text to format them correctly for the CRM.
answer.risk_reason: If the automation makes a mistake, an incorrect lead is created in the CRM which can be easily edited or deleted by Claire.
